rows.name: size
rows.description: Size of the button, big or small

rows.name: buttonIcon
rows.description: Accepts an SVG React component. The button to be displayed

rows.name: variant
rows.description: The desired styles can be applied through this.

rows.name: leftIcon
rows.description: Toggle the left icon, if true the icon provided will be displayed to the left of the label.

rows.name: rightIcon
rows.description: Toggle the right icon, if true the icon provided will be displayed to the right of the label.

rows.name: ariaLabel
rows.description: Label to be perceived by screen reader users. Always give a meaningful ariaLabel in case of icon only buttons.

rows.name: loading
rows.description: To show a loading spinner and indicate a loading state while some background operation is going on. This disables any button events but does not show the UI as disabled for some edge cases. If you want to show the button as disabled please set 'disabled' as true. With the primary button (when the button background is same as the loading spinner indicator) it is recommended to change the 'variant', set 'disabled' as true or pass a different "data-scheme" to 'loadingSpinnerProps' when loading.

rows.name: loadingSpinnerProps
rows.description: Props to pass to the loading spinner.

rows.name: loadingMessage
rows.description: Accessibility message when the button is loading

rows.name: textWrap
rows.description: If set to true the button's is expanding to the remaining area, to accommodate for the text wrapping
